title: Magnetohydrodynamics - Propelling Liquid Metal with Magnets!
summary: Tech Ingredients explains the principles of magnetohydrodynamics and builds several demonstrations, including propelling liquid metal and electrolytes with magnets and a railgun-style setup.
why: It comes up as a great explainer on magnetohydrodynamic drives and pumps in threads about silent submarine propulsion.

quote.text: There's a great video from one of my favorite YouTube channels about Magnetohydrodynamic drives.
